name: Driving Simulator Antwerp
summary:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - through Antwerp and its port.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a race cockpit: racing wheel, bucket seats, roll cage, shift lights and a live display. Reach out with your own hands - grip the wheel, work the gear stick, pull the handbrake - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
Move the stick through a real H-pattern and snap the next gear in - or switch to automatic.

48 KM OF REAL ANTWERP
Round the Ring from Berchem past Deurne and over the Merksem via
